sources.title: MRAe Île-de-France delegated opinion no. 019554/GUNENV of 14 August 2026 on the data-centre project at Paray-Vieille-Poste (Essonne)
sources.publisher: Mission régionale d'autorité environnementale (MRAe) Île-de-France, IGEDD; published on the Ministère de la Transition écologique, portail de l'évaluation environnementale
sources.summary: The regional environmental authority's delegated opinion of 14 August 2026 concerns the data-centre project at Paray-Vieille-Poste (Essonne), carried by SNC PARAY DC and RTE, issued within a building-permit procedure on the impact study dated November 2025; the authority acknowledged the referral by the Essonne prefect on 16 June 2026. The project parcel lies at the north of an industrial wasteland next to the A6 motorway and Orly airport that housed a former Air France training site, whose buildings are to be demolished. It comprises a main operating building with the IT halls (15,260 m2 footprint, 25,735 m2 of floor area), a generator building with 43 emergency generators of 292 MW thermal running on HVO, 1,321 m3 of fuel storage, 48 chillers, lithium-ion batteries, an RTE substation fed by a 225 kV underground line from the network 0.15 km away and 980 kWp of photovoltaic panels; waste-heat recovery to a nearby heat network is under study. The opinion is neither favourable nor unfavourable and is not a consent.

An environmental-authority opinion supports announced status only.

sources.title: Non-technical presentation note (Pièce n°1) of the environmental-authorisation application by SNC PARAY DC for a data centre at Paray-Vieille-Poste, published with dossier 24840 on the environmental-assessment portal
sources.publisher: SNC PARAY DC (applicant document); published on the Ministère de la Transition écologique, portail de l'évaluation environnementale
sources.summary: The applicant's non-technical note states that the application concerns the creation and operation of a data centre at 1 avenue du Maréchal Devaux, Paray-Vieille-Poste, on a former Air France training site whose buildings are mostly to be demolished, connected by a double 225 kV underground line from the RTE Rungis substation. The applicant is SNC PARAY DC (RCS Nanterre 931 460 943, registered office at Neuilly-sur-Seine), wholly owned, capitalised and managed by the Hines group. The site is bounded north by rue des Avernaises and the RER line, east by a hotel residence and avenue du Maréchal Devaux, south by rue Jean Mermoz and Orly airport and west by rue Marcel Albert and the N7. The project covers 29,655 m2 on part of a single cadastral parcel, AB 53; Air France owns the parcel and a promise of sale has been signed with SNC PARAY DC. The building is to hold 12 IT halls of up to 1,400 m2 each on three levels, with 55 MW of IT power available (4.6 MW IT per hall); initial supply is to come from a 10 MW Enedis substation over a 7 MW cable from the Rungis substation, about 2.5 years after the building permit ('fin 2028 / début 2029').
sources.date_semantics: Applicant document (document title v1 dated 7 November 2025; PDF created 29 May 2026) published on the portal with the August 2026 dossier; identity, parcel, ownership and design context only, not a status observation. sources.title: MRAe Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur deliberated opinion nos. 020291/GUNENV and 020695/A P of 1 September 2026 on the conversion of the former Saint-Louis sugar refinery at Marseille 15e - creation of a data centre
sources.publisher: Mission régionale d'autorité environnementale (MRAe) Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, IGEDD; published on the Ministère de la Transition écologique, portail de l'évaluation environnementale
sources.summary: The regional environmental authority's opinion, adopted on 1 September 2026, concerns the operation to create a data centre on the site of the former Saint-Louis Sucre factory in the 15th arrondissement of Marseille, whose developer is ESL PROPERTIES, a subsidiary of EDGED ENERGY. The authority was referred by the Bouches-du-Rhône prefect and the City of Marseille, both competent to authorise the project, for a building-permit and environmental-authorisation application filed on 25 November 2025 and completed on 18 June 2026 (acknowledged 2 and 15 July 2026); the public has been consulted in parallel since the commissioner opened the consultation site on 17 August 2026. Within a 46,807 m2 landholding that also contains the Studios de la Méditerranée, the data-centre plot is 17,156 m2; the operation (22,084 m2 of floor area as declared, with inconsistencies noted) comprises an R+3 data-centre building with nine IT halls, offices and plant, twelve emergency generators of 8.16 MW thermal each on HVO or domestic fuel, sixteen rooftop chillers, an HTB/HTA substation and a waste-heat recovery building; the existing 4.5 MW high-voltage connection is to rise to 9.5 MW with a second 20 MW 20 kV line. Works on the data centre are to last 24 months from a planned start in the fourth quarter of 2026. The opinion is neither favourable nor unfavourable and is not a consent.

sources.title: Alcalá de Henares city reports first stone of Nabiax ADC3 data-centre building
sources.summary: The city of Alcalá de Henares' news item dated 18 September 2026 reports the laying of the first stone of a new Nabiax data-centre building (ADC3) in the Campus Externo, attended by the mayor and the president of the Comunidad de Madrid.
